title: Drafts still name the deleted test files in a repro, notes or goal, so check tells a planner to add them as touches
goal: No open item's repro, notes or goal names _tools/test_bench.py, _tools/test_land_e2e.py, _tools/test_live_kb.py, _tools/test_backlog_portable.py or _tools/test_forge.py as a file to change (BG-jgahu3o2's repro, BG-rrutf5bf's and ST-fe76odtm's notes, ST-glgrhz33's goal): each is reworded to the kept tests or a tool run, or dropped under decision D-2tq4fhgs when it asks for a test of a component that is not critical, and backlog.py check prints no warning naming one of those files

run:
import subprocess,sys
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/backlog.py','check'],capture_output=True,text=True)
bad=[l for l in (p.stdout+p.stderr).splitlines() if any(f in l for f in ('test_bench.py','test_land_e2e.py','test_live_kb.py','test_backlog_portable.py','test_forge.py'))]
